Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation enlisting affiliates to deploy ransomware in return for 60-75% share of ransom payments
Breaching private computer networks and systems, hi-jacking data, holding stolen data for ransom, distributing stolen data when ransoms were not paid
Discoverer: Bulgaria's General Directorate Combating Organized Crime
Impacted Systems: Private computer networks and systems of 17 Canadian entities and others worldwide
Attack Vector: Use of email accounts (Microsoft, Gmail, Protonmail) linked to online forums (XSS.is, HackForums) for registration and activity
Uploading stolen files to online services (MEGA, ZoomInfo)
Exploitation of ransomware affiliate role to deploy malware
Indicators of Compromise: Tor payment and data leak sites associated with Netwalker ransomware operation
Seizure of 719.99591411 BTC from Desjardins' BTC wallet
Seizure of 15.725489349111 XMR from Monero wallet
Over CAD $330,000 seized from deposit boxes at National Bank of Canada
Devices containing approximately 20 TB of data seized
Dark websites seized by law enforcement
